actions.action: Water at soil level when top 1–2 cm of soil is dry, then let it drain fully
Pinch or cut off spent flower stalks and clear dead material from the crown
Move plant to a cool, bright spot out of hot midday sun
Place on balcony in bright shade or morning sun with afternoon shade
If plant stays limp with moist soil, slide it out of the pot and check the roots
If roots are rotten, repot in fresh free-draining mix with perlite or grit
Feed with diluted liquid fertilizer every 2–3 weeks while blooming
After flowering, plant in a shady garden spot or a larger pot

reason: The answer correctly calls the shriveled flowers spent blooms, but it frames the plant as declining from heat, wet soil and sun and buries the deadheading fix among unneeded treatments; nothing it recommends is likely to hurt the plant.
